entities.name: Commander Alaric of Benalia
entities.description: Benalish army commander who plotted against Gerrard with Lord Kastan and was slain.

entities.name: Alaric of Jamuraa
entities.description: Friend of Crovax who was killed by Maraxus at his desert mansion.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Rose in the Benalish army, slew Kastan and Alaric, and rejoined the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Lord Kastan
entities.description: Assassin's guild leader who collaborated with Alaric.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Minotaur who helped Gerrard slay Kastan and Alaric and later rescued Starke.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship whose crew Gerrard left and rejoined.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: Fugitive hidden at Alaric's mansion, captured, then rescued.

entities.name: Maraxus of Keld
entities.description: Mercenary warlord who killed Alaric and was killed in battle.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Offered to hide Starke at his friend Alaric's mansion; rescued Starke.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain whose abduction the crew sought information about.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane the crew sought information about.

events.summary: Alaric was the first to test Gerrard when he came to Benalia.
events.quote: Alaric was the first person to test him

events.summary: Gerrard discovered Kastan was collaborating with Alaric to be rid of him.
events.quote: Gerrard discovered that Kastan was collaborating with Commander Alaric

events.summary: Gerrard and Tahngarth slew Kastan and Alaric; Gerrard rejoined the Weatherlight.
Maraxus killed Alaric of Jamuraa and captured Starke while his ogres burned the estate.
events.quote: Maraxus caught up to Starke nonetheless, killing Alaric

events.summary: Maraxus was killed in battle, and Tahngarth and Crovax rescued Starke.
events.quote: Maraxus was killed, and Tahngarth and Crovax rescued Starke

relations.quote: Commander Alaric was the superior of Gerrard Capashen in the Benalish army on Dominaria
